name: Ammunition (Firearms): Flechette (5)
body:
A flechette is a metal dart in a leather casing that is far more accurate than a musket ball. A flechette round can only be fired from a musket, not a pistol. Flechette rounds deal normal damage, but they increases the musket’s base range increment to 100 feet.
